decision: Do not use the current dcaribou/transfermarkt-datasets snapshot as the Argentina 2016 appearance/minute source. Keep it as a candidate for recent Argentina and for other competitions only after measured coverage audits.

source.consumption_mode: Published dataset only; Football Intelligence did not scrape Transfermarkt directly.

upstream_history.arg1_added_commit_message_excerpt: Add first-tier leagues from Americas (BRA1, ARG1, MLS1, MEX1, COL1)
upstream_history.interpretation: The configured season list includes historical years, but the published ARG1 data measured today does not contain them. Configuration intent must not be treated as measured coverage.

non_claims: This does not say the dataset is low quality for competitions/seasons it actually contains.
This does not say Transfermarkt itself lacks Argentina 2016 data.
This does not treat the publisher CC0 declaration as a legal opinion clearing every possible upstream right.
No production data, player crosswalk, or database row was written by this spike.
